_about: Constants shared by the Python fleet twin (twin/) and the web app (app/). Values tagged DECK come from the Sundai Hack 145 Track 1 organizer slides.

mass_t_per_mw._about: Tonnes per MW of IT power, dry (no propellant). The app's 'deck' and 'light' presets reproduce these lines exactly.

light.levers: 500 W/kg thin-film solar, 2 kg/m^2 carbon-fiber radiators, space-stripped racks (-30% compute), chips at 330 K (less leakage, power factor 0.919)
